project.name: Northwind Traders
project.description: Northwind is the classic sample trading company: it buys specialty foods from suppliers and sells them to customers worldwide. This model normalises the well-known Northwind dataset to 3NF (addresses and countries extracted) for Databricks Unity Catalog, with governance tags, a sales-region hierarchy and reporting views.

catalog:northwind.name: northwind
catalog:northwind.description: Unity Catalog catalog holding all Northwind schemas.

schema:northwind.hr.name: hr
schema:northwind.hr.description: Employees, sales regions/territories and territory assignments.

schema:northwind.product.name: product
schema:northwind.product.description: Product catalogue: products, categories and suppliers.

schema:northwind.ref.name: ref
schema:northwind.ref.description: Shared reference data: countries and postal addresses.

schema:northwind.reporting.name: reporting
schema:northwind.reporting.description: Views and materialized views for reports and dashboards. Read-only; defined over the other schemas.

schema:northwind.sales.name: sales
schema:northwind.sales.description: Customers, orders and order lines: the transactional core.

table:northwind.hr.employees.description: Northwind employees, mostly sales representatives. Reporting line is self-referencing.

table:northwind.hr.regions.name: regions

table:northwind.hr.territories.name: territories

table:northwind.product.categories.name: categories
table:northwind.product.categories.description: Product categories: Beverages, Condiments, Confections, Dairy Products, Grains/Cereals, Meat/Poultry, Produce, Seafood.

table:northwind.product.products.name: products
table:northwind.product.products.description: Items Northwind sells: each has one supplier and one category.

column:northwind.product.products.quanti.name: quantity_per_unit
column:northwind.product.products.quanti.description: Packaging description, e.g. 10 boxes x 20 bags

column:northwind.product.products.units_.name: units_on_order
column:northwind.product.products.units_.description: Units ordered from the supplier but not yet received

column:northwind.product.products.reorde.name: reorder_level
column:northwind.product.products.reorde.description: Stock level at which to reorder

column:northwind.product.products.discon.name: discontinued
column:northwind.product.products.discon.description: true when the product is no longer sold

table:northwind.product.suppliers.name: suppliers
table:northwind.product.suppliers.description: Companies that supply the products Northwind sells.

table:northwind.ref.addresses.name: addresses
table:northwind.ref.addresses.description: A postal address. Extracted from Customers, Suppliers, Employees and the ship-to of Orders so that address attributes are stored once (3NF).

column:northwind.ref.addresses.region.name: region
column:northwind.ref.addresses.region.description: State, province or region (free text in the source data)

column:northwind.ref.addresses.postal_co.name: postal_code
column:northwind.ref.addresses.postal_co.description: Postal or ZIP code (text: formats differ by country)

table:northwind.ref.countries.name: countries
table:northwind.ref.countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes used by all addresses.

table:northwind.reporting.alphabetical_l.name: alphabetical_list_of_products
table:northwind.reporting.alphabetical_l.description: Active products with their category name, for catalogue listings.
table:northwind.reporting.alphabetical_l.definition:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.supplier_id, p.category_id, c.category_name,
       p.quantity_per_unit, p.unit_price, p.units_in_stock, p.units_on_order, p.reorder_level, p.discontinued
FROM northwind.product.products p
JOIN northwind.product.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE p.discontinued = false

table:northwind.reporting.current_produc.name: current_product_list
table:northwind.reporting.current_produc.description: Products that are still sold (not discontinued).
table:northwind.reporting.current_produc.definition:
SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM northwind.product.products
WHERE discontinued = false

table:northwind.reporting.customers_and_.name: customers_and_suppliers_by_city
table:northwind.reporting.customers_and_.description: One list of every customer and supplier with its city, e.g. for planning regional visits.
table:northwind.reporting.customers_and_.definition:
SELECT a.city, cu.company_name, cu.contact_name, 'Customers' AS relationship
FROM northwind.sales.customers cu
LEFT JOIN northwind.ref.addresses a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id
UNION ALL
SELECT a.city, s.company_name, s.contact_name, 'Suppliers'
FROM northwind.product.suppliers s
LEFT JOIN northwind.ref.addresses a ON a.address_id = s.address_id

table:northwind.reporting.employee_direc.name: employee_directory_masked
table:northwind.reporting.employee_direc.description: Employee directory safe for wide access: no birth date, home phone, home address or notes; last name reduced to its initial.
table:northwind.reporting.employee_direc.definition:
SELECT employee_id, first_name, LEFT(last_name, 1) AS last_initial, title, extension, reports_to
FROM northwind.hr.employees

column:northwind.reporting.employee_dire.name: last_initial
column:northwind.reporting.employee_dire.description: First letter of the last name

table:northwind.reporting.invoices.name: invoices
table:northwind.reporting.invoices.description: Everything needed to print an invoice: ship-to, customer, salesperson, carrier and line values.
table:northwind.reporting.invoices.definition:
SELECT o.ship_name, sa.street AS ship_address, sa.city AS ship_city, sa.region AS ship_region,
       sa.postal_code AS ship_postal_code, sc.country_name AS ship_country,
       o.customer_id, cu.company_name AS customer_name,
       CONCAT(e.first_name, ' ', e.last_name) AS salesperson,
       o.order_id, o.order_date, o.required_date, o.shipped_date, sh.company_name AS shipper_name,
       x.product_id, x.product_name, x.unit_price, x.quantity, x.discount, x.extended_price, o.freight
FROM northwind.sales.orders o
JOIN northwind.sales.customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN northwind.hr.employees e ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
JOIN northwind.sales.shippers sh ON sh.shipper_id = o.shipper_id
JOIN northwind.reporting.order_details_extended x ON x.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN northwind.ref.addresses sa ON sa.address_id = o.ship_address_id
LEFT JOIN northwind.ref.countries sc ON sc.country_code = sa.country_code

table:northwind.reporting.mv_monthly_sal.name: mv_monthly_sales_summary
table:northwind.reporting.mv_monthly_sal.description: Orders, net revenue and freight per calendar month.
table:northwind.reporting.mv_monthly_sal.definition:
SELECT YEAR(o.order_date) AS order_year, MONTH(o.order_date) AS order_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
       CAST(SUM(x.extended_price) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS revenue,
       CAST(SUM(DISTINCT o.freight) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS freight_total
FROM northwind.sales.orders o
JOIN northwind.reporting.order_details_extended x ON x.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_date), MONTH(o.order_date)

column:northwind.reporting.mv_monthly_sa.name: freight_total
column:northwind.reporting.mv_monthly_sa.description: Approximation: sums distinct freight values per month

table:northwind.reporting.mv_sales_by_ca.name: mv_sales_by_category_year
table:northwind.reporting.mv_sales_by_ca.description: Net sales per category and order year. Refreshed on demand or on a schedule; used by the sales dashboard.
table:northwind.reporting.mv_sales_by_ca.definition:
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, YEAR(o.order_date) AS order_year,
       CAST(SUM(x.extended_price) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS category_sales, COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM northwind.reporting.order_details_extended x
JOIN northwind.sales.orders o ON o.order_id = x.order_id
JOIN northwind.product.products p ON p.product_id = x.product_id
JOIN northwind.product.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, YEAR(o.order_date)

table:northwind.reporting.order_details_.name: order_details_extended
table:northwind.reporting.order_details_.description: Order lines with product name and the extended (net) price after discount.
table:northwind.reporting.order_details_.definition:
SELECT od.order_id, od.product_id, p.product_name, od.unit_price, od.quantity, od.discount,
       CAST(ROUND(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS extended_price
FROM northwind.sales.order_details od
JOIN northwind.product.products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id

column:northwind.reporting.order_details.name: extended_price
column:northwind.reporting.order_details.description: unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount), rounded to 2 decimals

table:northwind.reporting.order_subtotal.name: order_subtotals
table:northwind.reporting.order_subtotal.description: Net merchandise value of every order (sum of extended prices, excluding freight).
table:northwind.reporting.order_subtotal.definition:
SELECT order_id, CAST(SUM(extended_price) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS subtotal
FROM northwind.reporting.order_details_extended
GROUP BY order_id

column:northwind.reporting.order_subtota.name: subtotal
column:northwind.reporting.order_subtota.description: Sum of extended prices of the order lines

table:northwind.reporting.products_above.name: products_above_average_price
table:northwind.reporting.products_above.description: Products priced higher than the average list price.
table:northwind.reporting.products_above.definition:
SELECT product_name, unit_price
FROM northwind.product.products
WHERE unit_price > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM northwind.product.products)

policy:Financial Records.name: Financial Records
